title: Mara Chain: Rethinking Failure as a Stepping Stone for AI System Auto-Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2609.35855v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Optimizing deployed AI systems increasingly amounts to editing prompts, skills, harnesses, and code rather than model weights. Existing approaches commonly optimize these artifacts through propose-evaluate-select procedures, where candidate configurations are evaluated and only those meeting an acceptance criterion are selected. Yet our analysis shows that discarded candidates often contain information critical for subsequent optimization. Discarding them causes later proposals to revisit the same failure modes. We introduce Mara Chain, a refinement procedure that turns rejected candidates into stepping stones. Rather than discarding a rejected candidate, Mara Chain retains and iteratively refines it using evidence accumulated across preceding attempts. The procedure limits each refinement chain to a fixed depth and applies Pareto-filtered Top-N selection to bound the candidate pool. Across AppWorld skill optimization, TerminalBench 2.

translated_title: Mara Chain：重新思考失败——将其作为AI系统自动进化的垫脚石
translated_abstract: 优化已部署的AI系统越来越等同于编辑提示词、技能、工具框架和代码，而非模型权重。现有方法通常通过“提议-评估-选择”的流程来优化这些工件，即对候选配置进行评估，仅保留满足接受标准的候选。然而我们的分析表明，被丢弃的候选方案往往包含对后续优化至关重要的信息。丢弃它们会导致后续提案重复陷入相同的失败模式。我们提出Mara Chain，一种将被拒绝的候选转化为垫脚石的精炼流程。Mara Chain并不丢弃被拒绝的候选，而是将其保留，并利用先前尝试中积累的证据对其进行迭代精炼。该流程将每个精炼链限制在固定深度，并通过Pareto过滤的Top-N选择来约束候选池规模。在AppWorld技能优化、TerminalBench 2（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出Mara Chain方法，不丢弃被拒绝的候选方案，而是利用先前尝试积累的证据对其进行固定深度的迭代精炼，把失败转化为AI系统自动优化的垫脚石，避免重复相同的失败模式。
en_tdlr: Mara Chain retains and iteratively refines rejected candidates using evidence accumulated from prior attempts, turning failures into stepping stones for AI system auto-evolution rather than discarding them.
